description: This file contains assembly code generation for cryptographic operations related to GHASH, specifically optimized for SSSE3 instructions on x86_64 architecture. It includes functions for Galois field multiplication and GHASH computation, with detailed comments explaining the implementation and bit manipulations.

methods.name: process_rows
methods.description: Generates assembly code to process a specified number of rows in the GHASH multiplication table, handling carry reduction and table lookups.
